question:
I have a dbt project with the following directory structure:

├── models
│   ├── experiments
│   │   ├── experiment_1
│   │   ├── experiment_2
│   │   ├── experiment_3
│   │   ├── experiment_4
│   │   ├── experiment_5
│   │   └── experiment_6

with each experiment_* directory containing a number of models.

Is there a way to blanket disable, say, all models belonging to experiment_4?

I know I could just specify enabled: false, either in dbt_project.yml or in the config of the SQL statements for each individual model. But ideally there would be a DRY way of doing this somewhat closer to where these models are actually specified.
title: disable all dbt models in a folder
answer:
One way of handle it will add +enabled: false in dbt_project.yml file for the folder you want to disable. That will disable all the models inside the folder. Something like this.

models:
  your_profile_name:
    experiments:
       experiment_4:
         +enabled: false

An extra yaml property file can be used to config individual models, in this case disable a model.

version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_f1_dataset__constructor_results
    config:
      enabled: false
      
  - name: stg_f1_dataset__constructor_standings
    config:
      enabled: false
